# QnALog 1.5.3

English-language note output now uses English labels for active-version cards and English built-in mode prefixes for newly generated repolished notes.

## Changes

- Localize new active-version card labels to the current interface language.
- Use the English built-in mode prefix in newly generated repolished filenames and version metadata when the interface is English.
- Preserve existing note names, version labels, transcript content, and custom prompt names.

## User impact

- No settings schema, API key storage, provider configuration, or device-selection changes; no reconfiguration is required.
- Existing notes and derived versions are not translated or renamed.
- No user-facing features were removed.
